verdict.rationale: Alerting on specific conditions, with chat or email notifications, is a fair observability question for a cloud hosting platform like Fly.io, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documentation of a native alerting or notification feature. The only nearby items are a user self-hosting the third-party Uptime Kuma on Fly and a Slack-bot access-scoping example, and neither is a Fly alerting capability.
